DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩の前に案内図をご覧になっていますね。今日は歩く時間を決めていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the guide map before your walk. Have you decided how long to walk today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 午後の読書会が始まるまで少し歩きたいです。戻る時間を忘れそうなので、休憩する所で時計を見ることにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 戻る時間を忘れないため休憩地点を使う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to walk a little before the afternoon reading group starts. I might forget when to return, so I would like to check my watch at a resting place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Use a rest stop to remember when to return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図の広場には屋根のある休憩所があります。そこから先へ進む道と、入口へ戻る道が分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The square on this map has a covered rest area. From there, one path continues onward and another returns to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 広場に着くと一周するしかないと思っていました。そこから来た道を戻ることもできるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一周だけでなく折返しが選べると理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I had to complete the circuit once I reached the square. So I can also return the way I came from there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand you can turn back instead of completing the circuit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、図では戻れます。先へ進む前に時計を見て、余裕がなければ折り返す計画にしてはいかがでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, the map shows you can return. How about checking your watch before continuing, and planning to turn back if you have little time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。疲れていたら屋根の下で休みたいです。休憩した時間も含めて戻れるように考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 疲れたときの屋根下の休み方を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will do that. If I am tired, I would like to rest under the roof. I will plan to get back with the resting time included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Consider resting under the roof when tired. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 歩く時間だけ数えないことが大切ですね。読書会の会場へは、入口に戻ってから移動されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is important not to count only your walking time. Will you go to the reading group's venue after returning to the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口で一緒に参加する友人と会います。友人には、広場まで歩いて時間を見て戻ると伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 読書会の待合せと折返し方針をつなげる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am meeting a friend who is also attending at the entrance. I will tell them I am walking to the square, checking the time and returning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Connect the reading-group meeting arrangements with your plan to turn back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻る時刻が変わりそうなら、その方へ連絡してください。案内図は、休憩所の目印を確認できるようお持ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your return time might change, please contact your friend. Will you take the guide map so you can identify the rest area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休憩所を丸で囲んだ図を持ちます。そこで時計を見て、余裕がなければ休憩を短くして入口へ引き返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時計を見て休憩と戻り道を調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take a map with the rest area circled. I will check my watch there and, if time is short, shorten my rest and return to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the time and adjust your rest and return journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 読書会と散歩の両方を楽しめるとよいですね。時間と歩きやすさを確かめながら、気をつけていってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39202-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope you enjoy both your reading group and your walk. Take care, checking the time and how easy the paths are to walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: アクセス図をお持ちですね。行きたい施設の名前はどこに書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a map showing how to get there. Where is the name of the facility you want to visit written?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 上に書いてある交流施設へ行きたいです。停留所の名前が二つ似ていて、どちらで乗り換えるのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 交流施設へ行きたいが似た二つの停留所名で乗換え場所が不明だと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go to the community facility named at the top. Two bus stop names are similar, so I do not know which one to transfer at.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to visit the community facility but the two similar stop names make the transfer point unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 施設から渡された図で、降りる停留所と乗換え地点を分けて見ましょう。地図の矢印はどこまで続いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: On the map the facility gave you, let us distinguish the stop where you get off from the transfer point. How far does the arrow on the map extend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 矢印は広場前から施設まで続いています。もう一つの広場入口という名前を、同じ場所だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 広場前から施設への矢印を読み広場入口と混同したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The arrow runs from Hiroba-mae to the facility. I thought the other name, Hiroba-iriguchi, referred to the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the arrow from Hiroba-mae to the facility and explain your confusion with Hiroba-iriguchi. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前だけで同じ場所と決めず、路線の案内と照合しましょう。乗換えについて施設から説明はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us compare the route information instead of assuming they are the same place based on their names. Did the facility explain the transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話では一度乗り換えると聞きましたが、停留所名を聞き取れませんでした。その部分を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一度の乗換えを聞いたが停留所名を聞き取れず確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: On the phone I heard I needed to transfer once, but I could not catch the stop name. I want to confirm that part.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you heard there was one transfer but missed the stop name and want to check it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この図の連絡先にも確認できます。案内がそろってから、乗る便と乗り場を選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also check with the contact listed on this map. Once you have all the information, let us choose the service and boarding point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認している間にバスが来ても、行き先が分からないまま乗らずに待つほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 行き先が分からない便が来ても待って確認する方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if a bus comes while I am checking, it is better to wait rather than board without knowing where it goes, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will wait and check even if a service with an unknown destination arrives. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 目的地に向かう便か確かめてから乗りましょう。施設へ到着が遅れる可能性も連絡しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check that the service goes to your destination before boarding. Will you also tell the facility you might arrive late?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 乗換え場所を確かめるため、施設に電話します。到着が遅れそうなら、そのことも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗換え場所を電話で確かめ遅れそうなら到着の連絡もすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will call the facility to check where to transfer. If it looks as though I will arrive late, I will tell them that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm the transfer point by phone and mention any likely delay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では図の停留所名を一緒に整理しましょう。便が決まったら乗り場へご案内します。どうぞよいお出かけを。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us organize the stop names on the map together. Once we choose a service, I will show you the boarding point. Have a pleasant outing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 勤務先に出す書類についてお尋ねですね。求められている証明書を確かめるため、先方の案内を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about a document to submit to your employer. Could you show me their instructions so we can confirm which certificate is required?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: メールがありますが、証明書の名前をメモし忘れました。住所が分かるものと言われた記憶だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: メールはあるが名称を控えず住所確認用という記憶しかないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have the email, but I forgot to note the certificate's name. I only remember being told it should show my address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the email but did not record the name and only remember it was for address verification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記憶だけで種類を決めず、メールの該当箇所を見ましょう。提出先は何のために求めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look at the relevant part of the email instead of choosing a type from memory. Why does the recipient need it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勤務先への提出です。メールには氏名と住所の確認に使うと書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先へ氏名と住所を確認するため提出すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is for my employer. The email says they will use it to confirm my name and address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will submit it to your employer to verify your name and address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な記載項目が分かる部分を探しましょう。本人の分か、世帯の分かについて書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us find the part explaining the required information. Does it say whether it is for you individually or your household?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人の分とあります。ただ、省略してよい項目の説明は見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人分という指定はあるが省略項目の記載がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It specifies my individual record. But I cannot find any explanation of which entries can be omitted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that it specifies an individual record but says nothing about omitted entries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 省略する項目は提出先に確認してから選びましょう。今ここで確認の連絡を取れそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check which entries may be omitted with the recipient before choosing. Could you contact them now to confirm?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 勤務先の担当者は今会議中です。今日は必要な情報を整理して、返事をもらってから申し込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務先の担当が会議中なので情報を整理し返事後に申し込みたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The person responsible at work is in a meeting now. Today I want to organize the necessary information and apply after receiving a reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the person at work is in a meeting, so you want to organize the information and apply after their reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように進められます。種類と記載項目が決まった後、申込みの案内も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can proceed that way. Once the certificate type and required entries are decided, let us check the application guidance too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 証明書の名称と省略できる項目を勤務先に尋ねます。答えを持ってきて、申込み方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名称と省略項目を尋ね回答を持参して申込みを相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask my employer for the certificate name and which entries can be omitted. I will bring their answer and ask how to apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask about the name and omitted entries, then bring the answer to discuss applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: メールと質問を残しておくと確認しやすいですね。返事が届いたら、また窓口へお越しください。本日はご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Keeping the email and questions will make checking easier. Please come back to the counter when you receive a reply. Thank you for consulting us today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の続きを確認しましょう。分からない言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let us check the rest of the medical questionnaire. Are there any words you do not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 症状が持続するという言葉の意味が分かりません。違和感はありますが、ずっと同じではないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持続の意味が不明で感じ方は一定ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not understand what it means for symptoms to persist. I have discomfort, but it is not the same all the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you do not understand “persist” and that what you feel is not constant. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここでの持続は、続いていることを尋ねています。ご自身ではどんな変化を感じていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here, “persist” asks whether it continues. What changes have you noticed yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝はお腹が重い感じでしたが、昼には少し気にならなくなりました。今はまた違和感があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 朝の重い感じと昼の軽減と現在の違和感を順に述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My stomach felt heavy in the morning, but it bothered me a little less at noon. Now I have discomfort again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the morning heaviness, improvement at noon and current discomfort in order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その順番で担当者に伝えましょう。いつ始まったかは覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us tell the person responsible in that order. Do you remember when it started?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の夕食後だと思います。正確な時刻は覚えていないので、だいたいと書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日の夕食後という記憶を示し概略で記入してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I think it was after dinner yesterday. I do not remember the exact time, so may I write an approximate time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your recollection that it was after dinner yesterday and ask if an approximate entry is acceptable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 時刻が不明なら、そのことも書いてください。痛みや違和感の場所も、ご自身の言葉で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you do not know the time, please write that too. Can you describe where the pain or discomfort is in your own words?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お腹の真ん中あたりです。右か左か聞かれると、はっきり答えられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 腹部中央付近だが左右は明確に答えられないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is around the middle of my abdomen. If asked whether it is on the right or left, I cannot give a clear answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it is near the middle of your abdomen but you cannot clearly identify right or left. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からないところを無理に決めなくて大丈夫です。診療担当者に、場所がはっきりしないことも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You do not need to force yourself to decide what you do not know. I will also tell the clinician that the location is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 夕食後からだと思うことと、朝昼で感じ方が変わったことを書きます。場所は診療のときに説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開始の記憶と変化を記入し場所は診療時に説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write that I think it started after dinner and that the feeling changed between morning and noon. I will explain the location during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record your recollection of the onset and changes and explain the location during the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書けた範囲で用紙をお渡しください。続きは診療担当者へ引き継ぎます。それでは、待合席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please hand over the form with what you have been able to fill in. I will pass the rest on to the clinician. Please wait in the waiting area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届いた連絡についてのご相談ですね。どのような内容でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about a message you received. What did it say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない相手から、今日中に料金を払うようにメッセージが来ました。利用した覚えがありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らない相手から今日中の支払いを求められ利用の覚えがないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone I do not know sent a message demanding that I pay a fee today. I do not remember using their service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say an unknown sender demanded payment today and you do not remember using the service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 内容を確認します。メッセージに返事をしたり、書かれたリンクを開いたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the content. Have you replied to the message or opened any link in it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 返事もしていませんし、リンクも開いていません。画面を閉じましたが、メッセージは残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返答もリンク閲覧もしておらずメッセージを残していると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have neither replied nor opened the link. I closed the screen, but the message is still there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not replied or opened the link and have kept the message. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず残っている内容を見せてください。送信者の表示と受信した時刻も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, please show me what is still there. Let us also check the displayed sender and the time it arrived.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午前九時ごろ届きました。送信者の欄には会社のような名前がありますが、私は知らない名前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 九時ごろ届き知らない会社風の名前が表示されたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It arrived around nine this morning. The sender field shows something like a company name, but I do not recognize it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it arrived around nine and displayed an unfamiliar name resembling a company name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名前の表示だけで相手を確定せず、内容と合わせて確認します。同じ相手から続けて連絡はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the content too, rather than identify the sender from the displayed name alone. Has the same sender contacted you again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その後にもう一通来て、期限が迫っていると書いてあります。二通とも消さずに残しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限を急がせる二通目も削除せず保存していると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Another message came later saying the deadline was approaching. I have kept both messages without deleting them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you also kept the second message urging you about the deadline without deleting it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二通を順番に確認しましょう。相談を続けるため、記録の残し方もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the two messages in order. I will also explain how to preserve records so you can continue seeking advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受信時刻と送信者の表示を整理し、二通の内容をお見せします。返事をする前に相談できてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二通と時刻と送信者表示を整理して見せ返事前に相談したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will organize the received times and displayed sender and show you both messages. I am glad I could seek advice before replying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will organize and show both messages, their times and displayed sender, and that you sought advice before replying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では画面を一緒に確認してから、次の相談先を整理します。お帰りになる前に、分からない点もお尋ねください。ご相談に来てくださりありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: After checking the screen together, we will identify the next place to consult. Please ask about anything unclear before you leave. Thank you for coming to seek advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送する箱をお持ちですね。中には何を入れる予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a box to send. What do you plan to put inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族に小さな器と布を送りたいです。まだふたを閉めていないので、中を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 器と布を送りたく箱を閉めていないので見てほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to send a small bowl and some cloth to my family. I have not closed the lid yet; could you look inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask them to look inside the still-open box containing a bowl and cloth you want to send. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 内容を確認しましょう。器は箱の中で動きそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the contents. Is the bowl likely to move inside the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 布で包んでありますが、箱の端に空間があります。布だけでよいと思っていたので、詰めるものが足りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 器は布で包んだが箱に隙間があり詰めるものが不足していると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is wrapped in cloth, but there is space at the edge of the box. I thought cloth alone would be enough, so I do not have enough packing material.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the bowl is wrapped in cloth but there are gaps in the box and not enough filling material. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 梱包の案内を見ながら、器が動く部分を確認しましょう。家族から到着日の希望は聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check where the bowl can move while looking at the packing guidance. Has your family told you their preferred arrival date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 急ぎではありませんが、受け取れる日を先に聞くつもりです。発送方法の違いも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 急ぎではなく家族の受取り日を聞き発送方法の違いも知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is not urgent, but I plan to ask which days they can receive it first. I would also like to know how the shipping methods differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is not urgent, you will ask when your family can receive it and want to know the differences between shipping methods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる発送方法と条件は、内容と送り先を確認してご案内します。宛名は用意してありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain the available shipping methods and conditions after checking the contents and destination. Have you prepared the address label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所はスマートフォンにあります。ただ、建物名を短く書いてよいか分からず、まだ写していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所はあるが建物名の省略が不明で未記入だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The address is on my phone. But I do not know whether I may abbreviate the building name, so I have not copied it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have the address but have not written it because you are unsure whether to abbreviate the building name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 省略せずに確認できる情報を用意しましょう。梱包と宛名が整ってから、条件と料金を確かめられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us prepare information that can be checked without abbreviations. Once packing and addressing are ready, we can check the conditions and charges.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず箱の空間と宛名を見直し、家族に受取りの予定を聞きます。整ったら発送方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 空間と宛名を見直し家族の予定確認後に発送方法を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I will check the gaps in the box and the address and ask my family about receiving it. Once everything is ready, I will discuss the shipping method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the gaps and address, ask about your family's schedule, then discuss shipping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備してから、またお持ちください。器を送る条件を確認して進めましょう。ご家族への荷物の準備がうまく進みますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring it again once it is ready. Let us check the conditions for sending the bowl before proceeding. I hope preparations for your family's parcel go well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込先のメモをご用意ですね。入力前に確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a note with the transfer details. Is there anything you want to check before entering them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口座番号の一桁が、六なのか零なのか読めません。このメモだけで進めるのは不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口座番号の一桁が六か零か分からず入力が不安だと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot tell whether one digit in the account number is six or zero. I am uneasy about proceeding using only this note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot tell whether one account-number digit is six or zero and are uneasy about entering it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分からない番号を推測せず、相手に確認しましょう。名義の記載はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us ask the recipient rather than guess an unclear number. Is the account holder's name written down?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名字だけ書かれています。会社への支払いなので、正式な名義も聞き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名字のみのメモで会社の正式名義も聞き直したいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only a surname is written. Since this is a payment to a company, I also want to ask again for the official account name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the note has only a surname and you also want to reconfirm the company's official account name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号と名義を正確に確認してから進めましょう。支払う金額は別の書類で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us proceed after checking the number and name accurately. Can you confirm the payment amount in another document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 請求書には金額が書いてあります。メモの番号が合っているか、請求元に尋ねてから使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金額は請求書にあり番号は請求元へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The invoice gives the amount. I will ask the issuer whether the number on the note is correct before using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the amount is on the invoice and you will check the number with the issuer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認した情報がそろったら、振込の方法を選べます。費用についても知りたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you have all the confirmed information, you can choose a transfer method. Would you also like to know about the costs?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手数料を含めた金額を見たいです。今は振込方法も決めていないので、違いを説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 方法が未定なので手数料込みの金額と違いを説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to see the amount including the fee. I have not decided on a transfer method yet, so could you explain the differences?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the amount including fees and an explanation of the differences because your method is undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 方法ごとの案内で費用を確かめましょう。今日は確認だけにして、番号の返事を待ちますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the costs in each method's guidance. Will you just check today and wait for the reply about the number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は送金しません。請求元から正確な番号と名義を聞いてから、手数料と合計を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は送らず番号と名義の確認後に手数料と合計を見ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not transfer money today. After getting the accurate number and account name from the issuer, I will check the fee and total.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not send today and will check the fee and total after confirming the number and account name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認を済ませてから進めましょう。メモと請求書は忘れずにお持ちください。返事が届いたら、またご相談をお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us proceed once you have checked everything. Please remember your note and invoice. We look forward to helping you again when the reply arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: かごの商品を会計してよろしいですか。分けておきたいものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ring up the items in your basket? Is there anything you would like to keep separate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣人に頼まれたものが一緒に入っています。自分の分と別の会計にして、レシートも分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 隣人に頼まれた品物と自分の分を会計とレシートで分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The items my neighbor asked me to buy are in here too. I want them charged separately from mine, with separate receipts too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want your neighbor's requested items separated from yours for payment and receipts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらを先に会計するか決めましょう。隣人の品物はどれですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us decide which to ring up first. Which items are your neighbor's?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: パンと牛乳が隣人の分です。先にその二つをお願いします。残りは私のものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: パンと牛乳が隣人の分で先に会計してほしいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bread and milk are my neighbor's. Please ring those two up first. The rest are mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the bread and milk are for your neighbor and ask to pay for them first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つをこちらへ分けますね。袋はそれぞれ必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will separate those two here. Does each purchase need a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 隣人の分だけ袋が必要です。自分の分は持ってきたかばんに入れます。袋の代金も別の会計に入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 隣人分だけ袋を付け代金もその会計へ入れ自分は持参かばんを使うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only my neighbor's items need a bag. I will put mine in the bag I brought. I want the bag charge included in that separate purchase too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say only your neighbor needs a bag, its cost should go on that bill, and you will use your own bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋を含む内訳を確認しましょう。先の会計はどのようにお支払いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the breakdown including the bag. How will you pay for the first purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 隣人から預かった現金を使います。合計を聞いてから出し、おつりも隣人へ返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 隣人の現金で払い合計を聞いてから出しおつりを返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use the cash my neighbor gave me. I will hand it over after hearing the total and return the change to my neighbor too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will pay with your neighbor's cash after hearing the total and return the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 先の会計が終わったら、ご本人の分を進めます。支払いを変える場合は、次の会計前にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: After the first payment, we will proceed with yours. If you want to change payment methods, please tell me before the next transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つのレシートを分けて受け取り、隣人のおつりも別にしまいます。自分の支払いは次の会計で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: レシートとおつりを分け自分の支払いは次の会計で相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will receive the two receipts separately and keep my neighbor's change separate too. I will discuss my payment at the next transaction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate the receipts and change and discuss your payment at the next transaction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではパンと牛乳から始めます。二人分が混ざらないように確認しましょう。会計後は、品物をお忘れなくお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will start with the bread and milk. Let us make sure the two people's purchases do not get mixed. After paying, please remember your items when you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩道の表示についてお尋ねですか。どの場所で見かけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a sign on the walking path? Where did you see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池へ行く道に工事の表示がありました。遠回りすると長くなりそうなので、別の短い道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 池の道の工事表示を見て遠回りを避け短い道を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a construction sign on the path to the pond. A detour looks long, so I want to know another short path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you saw a construction sign on the pond path and want a short route to avoid a long detour. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通行できる区間を案内で確認しましょう。今日は池まで行くことが目的ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the guidance for the sections you can use. Is reaching the pond your goal today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池にこだわってはいません。少し歩いて座りたいだけなので、入口の近くでもかまいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 少し歩いて座れれば入口近くでもよいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not set on the pond. I just want to walk a little and sit down, so somewhere near the entrance is fine too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say somewhere near the entrance is fine if you can walk a little and sit down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口側の休憩場所を案内図で見ましょう。歩く時間について希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us look on the map for resting places near the entrance. Do you have a preference for how long to walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 長く歩くと疲れるので、短い区間を往復したいです。途中で引き返せる目印もあると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 疲れやすいため短い往復と引返す目印がほしいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Walking a long time tires me, so I want to go back and forth along a short section. A landmark where I can turn back would help too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you tire easily and want a short round trip and a landmark for turning back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内図の広場を目印にできます。現地の通行表示を確かめて、工事の区間には入らないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can use the square shown on the map as a landmark. Check the signs on site and do not enter the construction section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 広場の手前までで疲れたら、入口へ戻ります。戻る道が分からなくなったら、どこで尋ねればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 疲れたら戻り道が不明な際に尋ねる場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I get tired before reaching the square, I will return to the entrance. If I lose my way back, where should I ask?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where to seek directions if you are tired and cannot find the way back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この案内所の場所を地図に付けましょう。歩き始める前に、入口と広場の位置を見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us mark this information office on your map. Before you start walking, compare the positions of the entrance and the square.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口と案内所に印を付け、通行表示を見て短い道だけ歩きます。無理に池まで行かず休憩します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口と案内所を記して表示を確認し池に固執せず休憩すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will mark the entrance and information office, check the signs and walk only the short route. I will rest instead of forcing myself to reach the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will mark the entrance and information office, check the signs and rest without insisting on reaching the pond. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日の過ごし方が決まりましたね。地図を見られるようにお持ちください。どうぞ穏やかな散歩の時間をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have decided how to spend today. Please keep your map where you can look at it. Have a peaceful walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運行表示をご覧になっていましたね。ご予定に影響がありそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were looking at the service display. Is it likely to affect your plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 説明会へ行く予定ですが、列車が遅れていると出ています。開始までに着けるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明会の開始前に着ける見込みを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to attend an information session, but it says the train is delayed. I want to know whether I can get there before it starts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how likely you are to arrive before the information session starts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の情報を確認します。案内されている時間は変わることもあるので、確定した到着時刻とは分けてお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the current information. The announced times can change, so please distinguish them from a confirmed arrival time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表示の時間をそのまま到着時刻として伝えないほうがいいですね。説明会の主催者に遅れる可能性を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 主催者へ確定していない到着時刻を伝えない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I should not pass on the displayed time as my arrival time, right? I will tell the session organizer that I might be late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not give the organizer an unconfirmed arrival time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 事情を伝えておくとよいですね。列車を待つ間、運行情報の更新もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is good to let them know the circumstances. While waiting for the train, please check for service updates too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話をかけるために少し離れたいです。戻ったとき、更新された情報はどこで見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話後に運行更新を確認する方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to step away briefly to make a call. Where can I see the updated information when I return?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to check service updates after your phone call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この表示と案内放送を確認してください。電話は周りの通行を妨げない場所でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check this display and the announcements. Please make your call somewhere you do not obstruct others passing through.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路を空けて電話します。主催者に遅れて参加できるか聞いてから、列車を待つか決めてもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遅れて参加できるか主催者に聞いてから待機を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep the passage clear while calling. May I decide whether to wait for the train after asking the organizer if I can join late?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the organizer about joining late before deciding whether to wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、参加条件と運行情報の両方で判断してください。ご乗車になる場合の案内は、情報が更新されたら確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please decide using both the participation conditions and service information. If you board, check the instructions once the information is updated.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 主催者へ相談し、表示と放送を確認して判断します。出発が決まったとは伝えず、わかった情報だけ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確かな運行情報と参加条件をそろえて行動する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will consult the organizer and decide after checking the display and announcements. I will not say departure has been confirmed; I will only pass on what is known.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Act after obtaining reliable service information and the participation conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 次の情報が出たら表示をご覧ください。ご不明な点があればまたお声がけを。それでは、ご連絡がうまく取れますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please look at the display when the next update appears. Ask again if anything is unclear. I hope you manage to contact them successfully.
